item.title: Police say Casper man discharged firearm in assault on pregnant woman
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — A circuit court judge set a $75,000 cash or surety bond on Monday for a 30-year-old Casper man accused of pointing a gun in a pregnant woman’s face and pushing her across a room, allegedly causing her to fall and strike her stomach on a floor fan.
